01 — Overview

The post-production department your studio never had to hire.

Filmmakers love the day of the shoot — and lose their evenings to the timeline. This concept turns outsourced editing into something a studio can trust with its name.

ROLE

UX/UI, visual design, motion, front-end

SCOPE

Website, client panel, edit suite, admin

YEAR

2026 · concept

TOOLS

Figma, HTML/CSS/JS,
AI imagery

6

screen types — landing, sign-in, sign-up and three panels

3

audiences — the client studio, the editor, the business owner

1

idea carrying everything — an orange playhead

02 — The challenge

More bookings shouldn’t mean more nights in the timeline.

01

The backlog

Weddings, events and brand videos pile up on drives. Every new booking quietly adds to the queue.

02

The fear of outsourcing

Handing footage to a freelancer feels like losing your look — and risking the relationship with your own clients.

03

No room to grow

Studios turn down projects not because they can’t shoot them, but because they know who will be editing them.

How might we let a studio hand over the edit without handing over its style, its deadlines or its name?

03 — Audience

Built for small studios that shoot more than they can edit.

Two-to-five person teams filming weddings, events and content, booked out in the busy months.

Persona · fictional

“I’d take twice as many projects if I trusted someone else with the edit.”

Ola, 31 — founder of a two-person film studio, Kraków

GOALS
  • Say yes to more bookings
  • Deliver on the date
    she promised
  • Keep her signature look
FRUSTRATIONS
  • Evenings lost to
    culling and syncing
  • Freelancers who edit
    in their own style
  • Email threads
    full of notes
NEEDS
  • A partner who
    learns her style
  • Reserved capacity
    in busy months
  • Her name
    on every film
04 — Landscape

Between a freelancer and an agency.

Each existing option solves one part of the problem. None of them protects the studio’s style and name at the same time.

05 — Strategy

“You capture the moment. We make it last.”

Positioning: a quiet partner behind the studio — not another creative voice in the room.

PILLAR 01

Your style

We learn your look and write it down — reference films, grade, music, pacing.

PILLAR 02

Your time

A few clicks for you, the hours in between are ours. Capacity reserved before you need it.

PILLAR 03

Your name

White-label by default. Your clients never know we exist.

TONE OF VOICE
“Your style, documented once.”
“Our award-winning signature look.”
“The hours in between are ours.”
“Fast, cheap, unlimited revisions!”
“Judge the work first.”
“Trusted by 10,000+ happy customers.”

14 — Website

A title card, then the first shot.

The hero reads like the opening of a film. The playhead sweeps on its own and follows the cursor.

youshootweedit.studio
15 — Website sections

From footage → finished film

Five clickable stages, driven by scroll. The grade is dragged across the frame at Color.

Your style, not ours

The style guide is the product: references, grade, music, pacing and a feedback loop.

Simple for you. Systematic for us.

Your time in light bars, our time in orange — the split is the message.

Choose how closely we work together

Three levels instead of a price list. Tap your busy months on Reserved.

16 — Moments

Small interactions that tell the story.

Before / after on every format

Wedding, event, reel and podcast — each card is graded live by the playhead.

Your name in the credits

Type your studio name and the end credits become yours — white-label, felt rather than explained.
